title: A pleasant experience to enjoy the beauty and to learn the heavy history
text: This private tour is so far the best tour we had in Spain. The guide (his name is Eduardo, I hope I write it right) is very knowable about Alhambra’s heavy history, architectures and  landscapes. He is very patient with us as we paused often to take picture. He also answer our questions patiently.In this tour we have enjoyed the beauty of this unique place and also learned a lot of the heavy histories. We do appreciate the benefits of being in a private tour group where we can have good interactive conversations with the guide. It is worth of the money.
author: Honglu_S

title: Private tour- it’s worth it!!
text: A private tour was perfect for us.  It was very crowded but since we were only 3 with Virginia our guide, she was able to maneuver to the less crowded areas and was pleasant and knowledgeable.  She is a gem.
author: kcmartinez1957

title: Our guide Ruth was...
text: Our guide Ruth was superb! She was warm, funny & extremely knowledgeable about all aspects of the Alhambra. The depth & details in her knowledge were impressive & kept us intrigued for the 3 hour tour.
author: Ingrid_C

title: A visit to Alhambra.
text: Matías was an amazing tour guide for our visit to Alhambra.  He was very knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and friendly.  My husband and I learned so much and the 3 hour tour flew by.
author: ConfYank

title: Can not be better!
text:
It was a great experience, Eduardo has kept a pace that is in line with our group’s energy… :-)
We have learned a lot about  the palace, gardens and the history of Alhambra. 
We have taken great pictures.
He was fun and a great companion.
author: tunct_13

title: Great tour
text: Great tour of the 3 sections of the Alhambra with Debora, very engaging and pleasant. Enjoyed the tour very much.  Thank you!
author: SeattleSon2

title: Best trip and guide!!!!
text: Today was magical- we couldn’t have asked for a better day or guide to the Alhambra. Debra was waiting for us- in the cold- because she hates being late. She is so cultured, smart, charming, passionate- we just LOVE her!!!!
author: 538teclap

title: Alhambra morning tour
text: Epic morning at the Alhambra. We were a bit "scared" before doing this tour, as we arrived at the peak of a heat wave, but once we set foot in the Alhambra, everything was fine. Our guide was Matias, a fantastic host for this dream place. For almost 3 hours we toured the city of the Alhambra. Matias adapted very well to our rhythm, we never felt rushed. The treatment of the agency was fabulous. They gave us the indications to take advantage of this ticket, which not only includes the Alhambra, but also several monuments of the city.
author: miguelsC38GL

title: 5* tour
text: Without a doubt, the Alhambra is one of those places that deserves to be visited with a guide, otherwise it is just a beautiful place. Thanks to Edu, our guide, the Alhambra came to life. For about 3 hours we walked leisurely through the most spectacular islamic architectural monument you have ever visited. Thank you very much.
author: iesinha

title: Alhambra tour
text:
By pure chance I found this tour, since the tickets were sold out to visit the Alhambra. This ticket, a bit more expensive than the normal one, is totally worth it, since during 2 days we had access to almost all the monuments of the city. 

The Alhambra tour deserves a separate paragraph. Our guide was Matias. We could feel the vibrations of this monument, travel to the past, to that time when Islam reigned in the Iberian Peninsula and enjoy a place that is worth taking a guide.
author: Gabriel54321
